title: A Smooth Covariogram and the Transition Between Projection Bodies
summary: We introduce a smooth radial approximation of the covariogram of a convex body. The construction replaces the intersection \(K\cap(K+x)\) by the radial \((-p)\)-mean of \(K\) and \(K+x\), producing a family \(g_{K,p}\) which converges pointwise to the classical covariogram as \(p\to\infty\). For each fixed \(p>0\), the function \(g_{K,p}\) is smooth near the origin, and its Hessian is computed explicitly in terms of the operator defining the polar \(L_2\)-projection body.
